授業概要
In this lecture series, we will explore and debate the fundamental questions of the sustainable built environment: what kind of urban (or rural) life do we want? and how to achieve sustainability of the built environment? from multiple perspectives.
This course is structured into two distinct units, each addressing key aspects of sustainable built environments:
UNIT 1. SUSTAINABLE AND RESILIENT URBAN COMMUNITIES
This unit introduces the concepts of sustainability and resilience as they apply to urban communities. It explores the challenges and opportunities of urbanization, such as population growth, population decline, environmental degradation, social inequality, and climate change. It also examines the strategies and practices that can help urban communities become more sustainable and resilient, including green infrastructure, renewable energy, the circular economy, and participatory governance. The unit aims to provide students with a holistic and interdisciplinary understanding of the complex issues facing urban communities.
